questions: Should the train/test split ratio be fixed at 0.2 (80/20), or should it be configurable via a parameter?

Should the function return the test set predictions only, or also the training predictions or the test set features/labels?

Is the MSE calculated using the same formula as sklearn's mean_squared_error (default squared=True), or a custom implementation?
